why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the rewards page and connect a wallet Go to the Joule Finance rewards page and connect your wallet. The rewards page shows a profile with a points total and multiplier, and has Overview, Refer & Earn and Leaderboard tabs.
2 Step 2 : Lend or borrow on the money market Open the money market and supply or borrow a supported token. The rewards page counts lending points and borrowing points per day.
3 Step 3 : Use the bridge Send tokens across with the Joule bridge . The rewards page tracks bridge points and total bridge volume.
4 Step 4 : Check the Refer & Earn tab Open the Refer & Earn tab on the rewards page. The rewards page counts referral points and the number of referred addresses.
5 Step 5 : Check your points and the leaderboard Return to the rewards page to read your total, your multiplier and the leaderboard, and to see whether any weekly mission has opened.
